annotations.title: Official figure, restated as printed, with receipt (Level 2)

description: ANSWERS: "how many FHA loans did HUD endorse in <month>", "what share of FHA endorsements were purchase loans", "what is the FHA first-time homebuyer share", "what was the FHA Streamline share of refinances", "how many FHA loans are in force". Returns a figure from an official publication (today: HUD's monthly FHA Single Family Production Report) exactly as printed, with the document's SHA-256, table and row, period, the publisher's exclusion note (HECM excluded), revision status against the next edition, and a receipt. Nothing is computed by FinanceRateCalc; the receipt attests that this figure with this definition appears in that document. PARAMS: source (default hud-fhaprod), period (YYYY-MM; omitted = latest restated), figure (omitted = all figures of the edition). NOT FOR: HMDA application or origination counts (an endorsement is a loan insured after closing), denial rates, lender-level figures. Historical observation computed from the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2). Not a prediction about any individual application. Attribution: FinanceRateCalc, CC BY 4.0.

figure.description: Figure id, e.g. endorsements-count, purchase-share-pct, first-time-homebuyer-pct; omitted = all
